200.description: The upstream answer to a keyed command, relayed unchanged.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the answer is a replay of a stored one (any upstream write hop of the composition was replayed).

schema.description: A JSON document owned by the upstream contract; the BFF does not interpret it.
schema.title: Passthrough

400.description: A 400 problem: idempotency-key-required, idempotency-key-invalid, unknown-query-parameter, invalid-limit, invalid-cursor (relayed from the provider) or malformed-request (a NUL character in the query string or body, or an unreadable body).

404.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504), route-not-allowed (500), internal-error (500) and client-closed-request (499, the caller went away). Any route also answers 404 resource-not-found for a path it does not serve (or one containing NUL) and 405 method-not-allowed for a wrong method.

413.description: A 413 payload-too-large problem from the edge: the request body is over 1 MiB (checked before any upstream call).
